title: Figure 4: Device schematics for spin-transfer-torque (STT) experiments
description: Row of five color schematics captioned 'Figure 4. Device Schematics for STT Experiments', labeled 'mechanical point contacts', 'lithographycal point contacts', 'manganite trilayer junctions', 'electrodeposited nanowires' and 'lithographycal pillar devices'. Red arrows show electron current through a small constriction; per the caption, black (grey) indicates insulator and dark blue indicates magnetic material.
